About

ODL

Established in 2018, Ovi Developers Ltd. creates residential and commercial developments defined by thoughtful design, careful craftsmanship and precise engineering.

Our team of architects, engineers and project professionals takes every building from the first concept to the final detail, so each ODL address stays a lasting asset for the families who live there.
